admission.justification: The two member obligations hold only together: the extracted launcher and the packaged serving copy jointly guarantee that whatever a role-launch change touches, the surface that states it carries it in the same change, with the served copy derived and retired text staying retired.

guarantee: Each role-launch surface carries the change that reaches it, and every affected surface is updated by the same change: the dashboard launcher (INV-63Z0MN) carries a change to launch choices, and the packaged serving copy of canonical role, operation and onboarding text (INV-NNQR91) is regenerated from its authoring source. A change to one surface's own subject does not oblige the other; the served copy stays derived rather than hand-edited, no harness installs a copy of the skills, retired role text is not resurrected, and no shipped first-read text uses assignment_read.
